pr_title: drivers: adc: ads1x1x: add support for RDY pin
pr_body:
Some hardware configuration require rely on the ALERT/RDY pin to know when and ADC conversion is completed. 

* A pin called `int-gpios` can optionally be define in the DT.
* The polling thread is left as fallback, when the pin is not defined.
* The semaphore is only used if the thread is running 
* It introduces a new DT macro `DT_ANY_COMPAT_HAS_PROP_STATUS_OKAY`
Fixes #57952

issue_context.title: adc: ads1115: do conversion using the RDY pin
issue_context.body:
The ADC1115 and ADS114 have a pin called ALERT/RDY which is active while the conversion is performed. This is more reliable and preferred when the pin is available to the SoC.  

Currently the driver uses a polling thread.

I have successfully implemented and tested this feature, I will add a PR.
